runs.outcome: Real switch (hub halt, the 24 Sep payload replayed as the Safe): draw SpokeHalted(), protective repay through the Giver SpokeHalted(), venue repay SpokeHalted(), withdrawal SpokeHalted(), liquidation of an under-water position SpokeHalted(): nothing moves either way; the go-live payload restores draws and liquidations. The AaveDesk reads only the spoke's reserve flags, so during the hub halt it quoted NONE with 991.48 USDC available and recorded OPEN (no funds moved: the venue refused the draw). AAPLc reserve frozen: desk VENUE_FROZEN / HOLD_VENUE, draw Refused(21), protective repay 20.00 USDC from the user's reserve, new AAPLc supply ReserveFrozen(), a USDC borrow straight at the venue ok, liquidation ok. AAPLc reserve paused: desk VENUE_PAUSED / HOLD_VENUE, protective repay ok, withdrawal ReservePaused(), liquidation ReservePaused(). USDC reserve paused: desk VENUE_PAUSED / HOLD_VENUE, protective repay ReservePaused(), liquidation ReservePaused(). Every switch reversed returns the line to OPEN. 59 of 59 checks pass.
findings: The real Aave halt switch is the hub's SpokeConfig.halted, not the spoke's reserve paused/frozen flags. AaveDeskLib.stateReason and obligationStatus read only Spoke.getReserveConfig, so during a hub halt the desk quotes capacity and records OPEN while every venue action reverts SpokeHalted(). No funds can move (the venue refuses), but the record is wrong for the duration: the desk should also read Hub.getSpokeConfig(assetId, spoke).halted/.active for the collateral and USDC assets (VENUE_PAUSED or a VENUE_HALTED reason, HOLD_VENUE).
A hub halt also blocks repays, so the protective repay cannot run while it lasts; it blocks liquidations too, so a halted position is frozen in both directions until the go-live payload.
Aave freezes per reserve: with only AAPLc frozen, Aave itself still lends USDC against it; the desk refuses (VENUE_FROZEN) because it never lends against a halted asset.
runs.notes: Fork run, no transactions of its own: the three hashes are the real mainnet precedent (receipts checked by the runner). Scenario state is restored from one EVM snapshot between scenarios; liquidation checks stage an under-water position (borrow to health 1.10, AAPLc feed rewritten to 35% through the aggregator's transmission slot) before the switch is thrown.
